params.text:
Based on the contributor statistics for the thoughtbot/administrate project on the 'add-action-text-field' branch, the person with the most contributions in terms of number of commits is **Grayson Wright** with **203 commits**. Other top contributors include: Nick Charlton (125 commits), Tyson Gach (76 commits), dependabot-preview[bot] (60 commits), and dependabot[bot] (34 commits).

**Important Note:** This data is from the 'add-action-text-field' branch specifically. I attempted to switch to the main branch to get overall project statistics, but reached the step limit before being able to confirm if 'add-action-text-field' is the main/default branch or if the main branch would show different statistics. The project has a total of 842 commits across all branches.
